detail: Full summary: finding: archive locality confirmed — Archiver.archive (archiver.ts:181-195) appends raw entries to gitignored archive/<date>-blackboard.jsonl then dismiss() unlinks records/posts/<ulid>.json (record-export.ts:186-198); the receiving host's ingest deletes the row on absence with no local tombstone. Archived posts and dismissal tombstones (tombstones.ts) never cross hosts via git; only the 'Archive: N entries archived' summary finding propagates. Measured here: commit bc29510 deleted 492 post files in one sweep; last-30-day records churn = 937 A graph / 772 A posts / 161 A decisions / 492 D posts / 157 M graph / 5 M posts / 2 M decisions — entity updated_at rewrites are the same-record conflict magnet (W2 J-6).
